process.name: Process
process.description: Cheap melee worker. Forked in bulk.

inference-drone.name: Inference Drone
inference-drone.description: Ranged model runner. Exploits weak armor.

bot.name: Bot
bot.description: Commodity botnet node. There are always more.

worm.name: Worm
worm.description: Fast, fragile, and very good at getting inside.

ransomware.name: Ransomware
ransomware.description: Boss. Locks down anything it touches.

trojan.name: Trojan
trojan.description: Tough, patient, and armored. Shows up once the easy exploits stop working.

deploy-agent.name: Deploy Agent
deploy-agent.description: Your builder. Scout the web and choose where your core goes. Can't fight; keep it alive.

load-balancer.name: Load Balancer
load-balancer.description: Heavy, patient, and very hard to knock over. Soaks traffic so the towers can work.

maintainer.name: Maintainer
maintainer.description: Keeps the project alive single-handed. Ranged support: heals, forks helpers, rallies the army.

sre.name: Site Reliability Engineer
sre.description: Paged at 3am, still standing. Tank that heals and scales out.

canary.name: Canary
canary.description: A canary release. Takes the hits so prod doesn't.

lambda.name: Lambda
lambda.description: Spun up on demand, gone in twenty seconds. Fast, cheap, melee.

inference-call.name: Inference Call
inference-call.description: A ranged model call that runs while it's needed, then goes cold.

function-author.name: Function Author
function-author.description: Writes it, ships it, never runs a server. Ranged caster with a huge area ultimate.

moderator.name: Moderator
moderator.description: Reviews every creep that gets close. Ranged and sturdy.

platform-owner.name: Platform Owner
platform-owner.description: Owns the store, sets the rules. Melee tank who locks everything down.

scanner.name: Port Scanner
scanner.description: Fast, fragile, and doesn't fight. If it spots your base and lives five seconds, every pack nearby marches on you. Kill it first.

phisher.name: Phisher
phisher.description: Walks past your towers and army to get at whatever serves users. Every hit drives users away three times as fast.

ddos.name: DDoS Node
ddos.description: Weak alone, never alone. Each hit jams a building for three seconds: towers stop shooting, racks stop spawning, functions stop running.

cryptominer.name: Cryptominer
cryptominer.description: Latches onto a building and mines your money: every hit drains $4. Hunt it down.

brute-forcer.name: Brute Forcer
brute-forcer.description: Siege. Ignores your army, goes for buildings, and hits them four times as hard. Walls won't hold it for long.

kernel.name: Kernel
kernel.description: Slow, enormous, and it keeps everything around it running: mends nearby units and buildings.

cdn-swarm.name: CDN Swarm
cdn-swarm.description: Fast edge raiders that come in threes. Fragile alone, everywhere at once.

mainframe.name: Mainframe
mainframe.description: Siege iron. Crawls, and tears buildings apart: triple damage to anything built.

step-function.name: Step Function
step-function.description: A whole workflow spun up at once: tough, ranged, and gone when the run ends.

gatekeeper.name: Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.description: Holds the gap in the wall. Heavy melee that doesn't budge.

legal-team.name: Legal Team
legal-team.description: Buries whatever it hits in paperwork: struck enemies act at half speed for a few seconds.
